title: ObsidianServiceAdapter 双向同步扩展
action: Extend ObsidianServiceAdapter.sync to support bidirectional sync including reverse write and frontmatter mapping

changes: Add reverse sync: when direction includes 'export', write knowledge layer changes back to vault
Integrate FrontmatterMapper: during bidirectional sync, map YAML frontmatter ↔ SQLite metadata
Add change detection: compare mtime/hash on both sides, apply changes only where needed
Add conflict handling: when both sides modified, prefer newer mtime (configurable strategy)

estimated_changes: 80 lines to adapters.ts, 80 lines to tests
